paper title: Direct RNA sequencing enables improved transcriptome assessment and tracking of RNA modifications for medical applications
sample type: Native HEK293T RNA; poly(A)-selected; transfected experimental conditions
orthogonal reference: HEK293T GLORI-seq: GSE281749. Three GLORI biological replicates were generated, and RNA pooled from the same three replicates was sequenced using SQK-RNA004 for DRS CGLORI comparison.
notes:
HEK293T cells were transfected with artificial snoRNAs and EGFP/mCherry reporters to generate controlled pseudouridylation at premature stop codons. Case A targeted both reporter transcripts, whereas Case B preferentially targeted mCherry. These are native cellular RNA samples and retain endogenous m6A, but they are transfected experimental conditions rather than untreated HEK293T WT samples; possible effects of transfection and cell-culture batch should therefore be considered in m6A comparisons. 
Medium 
Suitable for technical m6A analysis and RNA004 benchmarking, but conditional for biological comparison because the samples are transfected rather than untreated WT.

paper title: Mapping human pre-rRNA processing and modification at single nucleotide resolution using long read nanopore sequencing
sample type: Fractionated rRNA/pre-rRNA from nuclear, cytoplasmic, nucleolar and nucleoplasmic compartments; enzymatically polyadenylated
orthogonal reference: IVT 18S/28S negative controls and known rRNA modification sites; no matched GLORI mRNA reference
notes: Specialized rRNA/pre-rRNA dataset, not mRNA. HEK293 RNA was fractionated into nuclear/cytoplasmic and nucleolar/nucleoplasmic compartments. Because rRNA does not naturally carry a poly(A) tail, the RNA was enzymatically polyadenylated for direct RNA sequencing. Suitable for rRNA processing and rRNA-modification analysis only, not transcriptome-wide mRNA m6A benchmarking. The project also contains HCT116 mutant samples and IVT controls, so select the HEK293 fractions only.

paper title: WarpDemuX-tRNA: barcode multiplexing for nanopore tRNA sequencing
sample type: Deacylated mature tRNA from the HEK293 small-RNA fraction; non-poly(A), splint-adapter/barcoded library
orthogonal reference: Species-specific tRNA reference alignments; no GLORI or mRNA m6A reference
notes:
Two independent RNA004 datasets of deacylated mature tRNA isolated
from the small-RNA fraction of HEK293 total RNA. Custom splint and
barcoded adapters were used. These are technical multiplexing datasets,
not poly(A)+ mRNA or standard biological replicates.
